title: Seagate's new hybrid drive raises some old questions
summary: The FireCuda Forge revisits an old idea, with some familiar questions.
body: Seagate doesn't think hybrid drives are done just yet. On Tuesday, the company announced the launch of the new FireCuda Forge line of storage drives. The new drives combine the high capacity of a traditional plattered HDD with the speed and responsiveness of a user-supplied solid-state drive (SSD). The new hybrid storage solution is Seagate's first to be powered and managed by the new Alkemi intelligent storage platform. The FireCuda Forge is available right now through Seagate's web store , and comes in 8TB ($699) or 20TB ($899) HDD configurations—neither of which includes the required SSD. Users will have to bring their own SSD, with some specific restrictions. The FireCuda Forge is compatible with M.2 2280 NVMe drives that are PCIe Gen3 or higher. The maximum supported NVMe capacity is 1TB, which means that's as much data as you'll be able to dedicate to storage on the "fast side" of the hybrid setup. The NVMe will require minimum speeds of 2,400MB/s read and 2,000MB/s write, and a unit with DRAM cache is recommended. title: The US military seems to be getting nervous about the launch supply crunch
summary: "Launch is extremely constrained and that is exactly the situation we predicted."
body: The US military is taking a new approach to prop up commercial launch companies as SpaceX looks to wind down its Falcon rocket program, suggesting defense officials see the workhorse rocket's retirement as a potential national security risk. The Pentagon's Office of Strategic Capital has twice in the last two weeks announced it was sending cash to two of SpaceX's competitors in the launch business. First, on October 26, the office announced a $150 million conditional loan commitment to Stoke Space. Military officials revealed a second $150 million Pentagon loan Tuesday for Rocket Lab. Stoke Space and Rocket Lab are the first two launch companies to receive significant support from the Office of Strategic Capital (OSC), an organization established in 2022 to infuse companies developing "vital" national security technologies with capital. OSC has been on a loan spree in recent weeks, committing hundreds of millions of dollars to companies specializing in batteries, drones, and semiconductors. In the space sector, the office also provided a $150 million loan to LeoLabs , a commercial satellite tracking company, for production and deployment of radar units. Read full article Comments

title: Ring cameras go mobile as Amazon debuts AI-powered security drone and robot
summary: Amazon's roaming Ring Robotics devices will debut in late 2026 and early 2027.
body: Amazon is betting that many Ring customers will also want an AI-powered security drone and robot patrolling their homes or offices. But the company’s upcoming Ring Robotic products are also certain to intensify privacy concerns previously raised around a prior Amazon attempt to popularize a flying security camera. The Ring Rover Cam and Ring Drone Cam are expected to reach customers starting at the end of 2026 and in early 2027, respectively, according to an Amazon announcement posted on November 10. Amazon describes the devices as relying on an AI Pilot system that uses each device’s cameras along with “specialized vision models, on-device sensors and cloud processing” to plan patrol routes while autonomously navigating around obstacles such as furniture. Both devices also use that AI Pilot system to digitally map the floor plan of the customer’s home or business. title: هل اقتربت نهاية الرحلة؟.. فان دايك يزيد الغموض حول مستقبله مع ليفربول
summary: عقده ينتهي في يونيو المقبل
body: عقده ينتهي في يونيو المقبل أثار الهولندي فيرجيل فان دايك، قائد ليفربول، الجدل حول مستقبله مع النادي الإنجليزي، حيث ينتهي عقده عقب الموسم الجاري. ولا يبدو أن فيرجيل فان دايك، قلقٌ بشأن مستقبله مع ليفربول، فمع انتهاء عقده مع الريدز في يونيو المقبل، لم يتخذ المدافع الهولندي البالغ من العمر 35 عامًا قرارًا بعد بشأن خطوته التالية.  ومن المتوقع إجراء محادثات مع إدارة النادي في الأسابيع والأشهر المقبلة، لكن القائد يُفضّل التركيز على الموسم الحالي. وأوضح فان دايك، وفقا لموقع " فوت ميركاتو ": "أريد الاستمرار في اللعب وتقديم أفضل ما لدي، لذا سنرى ما يخبئه لنا الموسم". وأضاف: "إذا استمر الوضع على هذا المنوال، فذلك أفضل. وإذا لم يستمر، فسأنتقل إلى نادٍ آخر. لا جديد يُذكر حاليًا، لكن هذا لا يعني أنني أشعر بالذعر". ناقش الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات كووورة وزاد: "حالتي النفسية جيدة؛ أما من الناحية البدنية، فقد عانيت من مشكلة طفيفة خلال الأسبوعين الماضيين، لكنني أبذل قصارى جهدي لأكون جاهزًا للعب". يذكر أن ليفربول، تعاقد مع فان دايك، في يناير  2018، ليصبح أحد أبرز نجوم الفريق خلال تلك السنوات.

title: Democrats oppose plan to stack FCC with Republicans, plan probes of Chairman Carr
summary: Democrats accuse FCC nominee of evading questions about Carr, her current boss.
body: Senate Democrats today opposed President Trump's nominee for an open Federal Communications Commission seat, and criticized Republicans for moving to confirm a new commissioner during the period before Democrats take control of Congress in January 2027. Democrats also plan to use their majority next year to launch probes of FCC Chairman Brendan Carr. "After the American people last week overwhelmingly rejected the MAGA agenda, there is no justification for this committee to advance partisan nominees during the lame-duck period," Sen. Ed Markey (D-Mass.) said today at the Commerce Committee's nomination hearing for Danielle Thumann Severs, Trump's pick to fill an empty commissioner's seat. Thumann Severs, an attorney and senior counsel to Carr, faced questions from Democrats about whether she supports Carr's attacks on TV broadcasters. Read full article Comments

title: منتخب فرنسا يعلن عودة تشواميني إلى ريال مدريد.. وقرار مفاجئ من زيدان
summary: الضحية الثالثة في معسكر الديوك خلال ساعات قليلة
body: الضحية الثالثة في معسكر الديوك خلال ساعات قليلة تلقى زين الدين زيدان ضربة جديدة في معسكر منتخب فرنسا، بعدما أعلن الاتحاد الفرنسي غياب أوريلين تشواميني عن المباراتين المقبلتين أمام إيطاليا وتركيا في دوري الأمم الأوروبية، بسبب الإصابة، ليصبح ثالث لاعب يغادر قائمة "الديوك" خلال الساعات القليلة الماضية. وجاء قرار استبعاد لاعب الوسط الدولي بعد الإصابة التي تعرض لها في منطقة العانة، والتي منعته من استكمال الحصة التدريبية ، اليوم الثلاثاء، ليعود إلى ناديه ريال مدريد. وأوضح الاتحاد الفرنسي لكرة القدم، في بيان رسمي، أن تشواميني شعر بآلام عضلية منذ وصوله إلى مركز كليرفونتين، مشيرًا إلى أن الجهاز الطبي للمنتخب قرر، بالتنسيق مع اللاعب وبعد التواصل مع أطباء ريال مدريد، إعادته إلى ناديه. وجاء في البيان: "يشعر اللاعب بهذه الآلام منذ وصوله إلى كليرفونتين. ونظرًا إلى تاريخه الطبي، وبعد التشاور قبل دقائق مع أطباء ريال مدريد، قرر الجهاز الطبي لمنتخب فرنسا، بالاتفاق مع اللاعب، إعادته إلى ناديه. وسيقضي الليلة مع المجموعة، قبل أن يغادر غدًا إلى مدريد". title: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
summary: Researcher finds 35,000 Grok Build apps wide open to anyone who looked for them.
body: Grok Build, the vibe-coding agent from SpaceXSI, is leaking data—some of it proprietary business information and other sensitive secrets—from thousands of its users, including the very same Elon Musk-owned company that offers the platform, new research shows. The information is revealed through links allowing Grok Build users to share their apps with others. Grok takes steps to randomize the URLs so only people who know the exact URL can access the data stored there. A design decision by developers of the platform, however, completely torpedoes that objective and makes it possible for anyone to enumerate thousands of live Grok Build projects. Except in rare cases, clicking those links opens the app and reveals all data associated with it. You had one job Research from security firm Claroc shows that the exposed data includes things like internal business plans, ad proposals, medical exam results, galley checklists from a celebrity cruise line, and employee names and ID numbers. Ironically, some of the sensitive data comes from two-dozen apps built by SpaceXSI (the name of the now-merged SpaceX and xAI) itself. title: What happens to mathematics when AI becomes an oracle?
summary: Mathematician Steven Strogatz discusses his new book, Big Math: The Hidden Codes That Run Our World.
body: Our modern world runs on math, from social media algorithms, package delivery, and weather prediction to medical imaging and machine learning. The rise of computers helped fuel its dominance, enabling us to work with increasingly large numbers that would otherwise be beyond the capacity of our finite human brains. But with the rise of large language models, AI chatbots, and, soon, quantum computing, so-called "big math" is beginning to outstrip its creators entirely. What that means , and how we might adapt, is the focus of a new book, Big Math: The Hidden Codes That Run Our World , by applied mathematicians Steven Strogatz and Alex Townsend. Strogatz is perhaps best known in his field for his co-authorship of a seminal 1998 paper with Duncan Watts on the collective dynamics of small-world networks. He has also studied chaos theory as applied to physics, the geometry of supercoiled DNA, and the biological collective oscillators, such as swarms of synchronously flashing fireflies and crickets that chirp in unison. title: بدعم من جوارديولا.. مدرب إسباني ينافس إنريكي في فرنسا
summary: بديل باولو فونسيكا
body: بديل باولو فونسيكا ساهم بيب جوارديولا، مدرب مانشستر سيتي السابق، في تعاقد ليون الفرنسي، مع مدرب جديد خلال الساعات الماضية. قدّم نادي أولمبيك ليون مدربه الجديد، الإسباني كارلوس فيسينس، حيث سيخلف المدرب السابق لنادي براجا، البالغ من العمر 43 عامًا، باولو فونسيكا، الذي انتقل إلى سبورتينج لشبونة.  وقد حظي مدرب ليون الجديد بدعم كبير، حيث أشاد به بيب جوارديولا، الذي عمل معه مساعدًا في مانشستر سيتي لمدة خمس سنوات. ناقش الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات كووورة وكشف المدير العام لنادي أولمبيك ليون، مايكل جيرلينجر، في مؤتمر صحفي أنه تواصل مع المدرب الإسباني للاستفسار عن فيسينس. وقال: "تحدثتُ مع جوارديولا، الذي أشاد كثيرًا بكارلوس. بالنسبة لنا، كان القرار الأمثل في النهاية هو السماح لباولو بالانضمام إلى نادي طفولته، وقد اخترنا كارلوس". وتابع: "عندما تتحدث مع بيب، يكون حديثه من طرف واحد، ويكون إيجابيًا. تحدث معي عن الكرات الثابتة والعقلية. أخبرني أن كارلوس شخص رائع للغاية. نصحني بالمضي قدمًا والتحدث معه". ويحتل ليون المركز الخامس في ترتيب الدوري الفرنسي، برصيد 17 نقطة بفارق 6 نقاط عن سان جيرمان المتصدر، والذي يقوده إسباني آخر هو لويس أنريكي.

title: Google Fi adds support for a second 5G network, won't say which one
summary: Fi has always supported T-Mobile, but the new one? Google won't say.
body: Google has announced a " super network " upgrade for its Fi cell service. For the past few years, Google Fi has operated exclusively on the T-Mobile network, but now it's adding support for a second 5G network. Oddly, Google refuses to say which one. Google's MVNO (mobile virtual network operator) launched in 2015 as Project Fi with support for both T-Mobile and Sprint service. The service initially only worked on Google's Nexus phones, which would switch between networks based on signal strength. After T-Mobile absorbed Sprint, Fi switched to being a single-network service in the US while continuing to hop between networks for international travel. With the super network, Google Fi is again a dual-carrier service stateside. Phones connected to Fi will be able to hop between T-Mobile 5G and a different 5G network to provide the best possible connectivity. Google's blog post announcing the change conspicuously doesn't mention either network, saying only that it supports "two of America’s best 5G cellular networks." Read full article Comments

Valve acknowledges that players enabling VSync or frame rate limits can bias the collected data somewhat and that the measurements don't account for custom in-game settings that Steam Deck users may tinker with to get a game running. title: High oil prices have led to a dip in global carbon emissions
summary: Bucking recent trends, fossil fuel emissions look to be down 0.4 percent.
body: Evaluating the annual global temperatures each year requires context. There is a fair amount of natural variability from one year to the next, so it’s important to focus on the trend over time. Famously, global warming did not end in 1998, as some claimed a couple of decades ago—we just had a run of La-Niña-dominated years after a very strong El Niño. Annual greenhouse gas emissions are much less variable, having increased fairly steadily, but many complicating factors can still muddy the picture. Sometimes those factors conspire to throw a year off the trend. It looks like 2026 will be one of those years. A new analysis led by Corinne Le Quéré at the University of East Anglia estimates that fossil fuel emissions have fallen about 0.4 percent from last year. This probably isn’t a peak that symbolizes heartening progress on climate change, though; the researchers think it’s a short-term dip driven by the war in Iran and its effect on oil prices. title: Man who lost $308,000 on sports bets sues Kalshi for offering illegal gambling
summary: Lawsuit demands Kalshi return losses because online betting is illegal in Washington.
body: A man who lost over $308,000 making sports wagers on Kalshi is suing the prediction market for violating the state of Washington's ban on online gambling. He's trying to turn those losses into an overall victory with a lawsuit seeking a payment of over $580,000. Bellevue, Washington, resident Scott Bright's "wagering occurred at a time when it was unlawful in Washington and when the Washington Attorney General had already sued KalshiEX LLC in this Court alleging precisely that," said the gambler's lawsuit filed on September 24 in King County Superior Court. Kalshi has since filed a motion to dismiss the lawsuit. While state attorneys general throughout the US are trying to shut down Kalshi for allegedly violating state gambling laws, Bright's case tests whether unsuccessful gamblers can obtain restitution from the company through individual lawsuits.
